reviews.text: Very professional and kind staff. Everything was clearly explained and the billing was transparent and reasonably priced.
Excellent service from the nurses and very good medical care, the wait wasn't too long, a clean place, I recommend it 👍
Paid 300 for them to look at my kitten...

We had a really good experience here. We came in at a time when they weren’t too busy, and they were able to help us right away, which we really appreciated. Everyone was very attentive, friendly, and professional from the moment we walked in. They took the time to listen to our concerns, explained everything clearly, and made sure our dog was comfortable and well taken care of. The whole visit went smoothly and we never felt rushed. Overall, we were very happy with the care we received and would definitely come back if we ever need them again.

I brought my dog in for an unexpected emergency today and paid 1024 dollars. My issue was never the additional 30 dollars. It was the dismissive and condescending way I was treated.

I had just undergone surgery myself and needed to pick up my medication before getting my dog. When I explained the short delay Andrea responded with comments like this is a hospital not an animal care center and you have to pick up your dog. I understand the policy but this is urgent care. Emergencies are unexpected and some flexibility and compassion toward customers should be expected.

Joanne then called and told me not to use Andreas name and to put the complaint under her name instead. When I explained that Andrea had been dismissive Joanne argued that she had been very kind to me. You cannot tell a customer how they experienced an interaction or who they are allowed to complain about.

The entire interaction made me feel like the focus was on money and rigid policy rather than compassion for an animal and an owner dealing with an emergency. Thankfully they were nicer when I arrived but the phone interactions were completely unnecessary and disappointing.

The rest of the staff was amazing especially the younger receptionist that checked us out I did not get her name. Also, we love the main doctor she’s patient and amazing as well. It’s just my experience today with back and forth with the staff on the phone. Not very pleasant when your dog is experiencing such thing and then they act like this.

Incredibly compassionate and kind. I arrived with my two 11 year old daughters and our family cat who was dying. They rushed out and brought us right in to a private room. Our cat, Olivia, died my my daughter's arms on the way in. My daughters were distraught and the staff was incredibly kind and accommodating. Thanks to the staff!

I’m so glad I found this vet hospital. The prices were reasonable (not cheap but this is medicine and it should not be cheap!). They saw my dog on a Sunday for an emergency and let me review the estimate on the phone so I didn’t have to sit all night waiting while they treated my pet. Very technologically advanced clinic. All of the staff were friendly and helpful. I met Dr Ji Lee and she was great and explained the treatment and next steps in case my dog doesn’t improve. Will definitely come back here next time my regular vet is closed. Thank you all.

Took my cat here for treatment during an emergency need for stitches. It was a Sunday and our standard vet was not open. We went early and were there pretty much as the doors opened. The entire ordeal was about 2 hours, the doctor was great, and treatment was fairly priced. I was genuinely concerned of cost since this is an urgent care. I was happy to see we were treated well.

Came here for a cut paw pad. The staff are lovely and you can tell they’re really good at their jobs. I will say I came here to hopefully avoid the long ER wait but ended up waiting quite a while (approximately 3 hrs). I’d come here again but be prepared to wait a while and bring a coat because it’s absolutely freezing in the lobby. The prices aren’t terribly cheaper than the ER - $135 for the visit and almost $200 to put ointment on his paw and pack it and bandage it. The staff were fantastic, though
Good experience the people are wonderful! I would definitely bring my dog back here

I’m so glad we heard about Animal Urgent Care in K-Town.  The whole experience was wonderful — from beginning to end.  Easy to walk in, when our regular vet and everybody else said they were booked;  easy to sign up, when you’re nervous for your pup and making an account is not really at the top of your list; and clear and well-communicated when they take your dog (Theo, in this case) in the back to do preliminary checks; and then even better when you meet the doctor.  Dr. Travis Linney is great: very straightforward yet very warm and understanding, knowledgeable and wise — and very sensible!  We arrived at a treatment plan together and an hour or two later I was driving the little guy home.  And today, he’s so much better.  Night and day.  Thank you all! (!!!)

The staff here was knowledgeable and took their work very seriously. They clearly care for animals and what is in their best interest.

I left feeling reassured and would return if one of my little angels was in need.

They were available and prompt to respond to all my questions and concerns after the visit, and made me feel very comfortable.

Could not be more thankful for the peace of mind I got from my visit, and the kindness of the staff.

My 14 year old beagle had a little medical issue yesterday that caused him not to be able to walk. It was pretty scary, so I called them and they said they weren’t too busy and I brought him in. They took good care of him and sent us home with some meds saying he should be fine in a few days. They were very helpful explaining everything to me from what most likely happened to the care I was going to give him for the next couple weeks so that he completely recovers. He’s walking around today (with some minor balance issues), so I’m very relieved. Everyone was really helpful including the two women at the front desk and Dr Linney. Really glad I found them so last minute.
Very poor and overpriced services
They push these extremely expensive treatments and shame you as a pet parent if you’re not able to afford it

This Emergency Vet was very helpful and Super kind.
From the initial phone call when I noticed an abnormality in Sage to the follow up from Dr. Linney were  incredible. They took Sage in right away after I arrived.
For it being my first ever experience at an urgent pet care clinic, the staff made it easy to provide the help my pupper needed. Thank you all for helping her feel better.

This facility is very understanding and caring. I had to put my cat down and they were very compassionate with me gave me as much time as I needed with my little guy. I could tell staff truly cared for my cat and me.

I couldn’t boast more about this practice if I tried! Dr. Goodman and Dr. Linney are the best! Every single time I’ve come here, even under very stressful situations, I am met with such grace, care & kindness by the entire staff! Especially the Doctors which is so important to me! They always find a way to comfort me through sharing knowledge (and even over sharing through answering the 1000 questions I always have). I will not bring my dogs anywhere else! I trust everyone at this practice to handle my dogs with love, care, and compassion. 20/10! Also, the pricing is so fair and they have even offered me refunds (which has never happened to me before) whenever they might have not needed to do as much as they thought! Truly a place that makes your animals feel cared for first before the dollar signs!

My dog Butters was my first everything. 15 years of love and loyalty. It was time for him to be at peace and I called 18 different service providers (including his vet of the last decade). This hospital answered my call and many questions with compassion and didn’t treat this like a transaction. They were busy, had other patients, but made my family feel we were the only ones being taken care of. He went with love and dignity. You have to be a collective of special people to be able to provide a service like this for a dog you just met. To top it off, they mailed me a HANDWRITTEN CARD. My family and friends are in NY so to receive this was also the first time LA felt like home to my family. I’m eternally grateful. Imagine how well they do other things, if they performed this difficult service in this manner. 5/5!

Cannot say enough good things about this place. They took great care of our poorly cat. They were kind and attentive. The vet was amazing. So detailed and spent lots of time with us. These are good people. Take your pet to see them.

I came in with my dog who was bitten at a dog park and they saw us immediately, were so kind and caring and took great care of my dog. They walked me through the process, kept me updated and informed as she was being treated, and Dr. Mathias was incredibly kind and made me feel at ease under her care. Thank you for taking such good care of us.

We had a very disappointing experience at KTown Animal Urgent Care. They would not allow my wife to accompany our dog into the treatment area, and the way they communicated this came across as insensitive and asinine. Bringing a beloved pet to urgent care is already stressful, and it is not easy to hand your dog over to people you have never met without being offered reassurance, transparency, or compassion. Even if this is their policy, it should have been handled with far more empathy and understanding. Their dismissive approach made an upsetting situation unnecessarily worse, and we did not feel comfortable entrusting our dog to them.

My little baby suffered for three days to the point that blood was mixed in her stool.I know it’s expensive because other hospitals couldn’t get appointments, but I chose this place. There was a person named Dr. Ji Lee who spoke Korean there, and I was able to hear a more detailed and kind explanation.  Branching system and lactic acid bacteria.I was prescribed subcutaneous fluid and told to watch for a few days. My baby still has loose stools, but I’m relieved and waiting, hearing the doctor say it will get better gradually. My dog is a 15-year-old senior dog, so I was very worried, but Dr. Ji Lee’s easygoing and kind manner was enough to reassure me and satisfy me completely. Unlike other hospitals, she didn’t leave after saying a few words to another patient. He explained all sorts of things I was curious about in detail. The price is not the problem. The very fact that such a kind doctor exists in Koreatown is truly satisfying and something I’m grateful for, as someone who has an elderly dog. Thank you once again  dr ji lee.

My beloved Penelope Jones had emergency pyometra surgery at another location. She was given pain medication and antibiotics at a dose too high for her and she became sicker. She was straining to try relieve herself to know avail. Whining in pain, panting, unable to sleep or get comfortable. Took her to Animal Urgent Care Koreatown she was given an enema, pain meds and correct dosage of antibiotics. Thank you to the vet and all the staff who took such great care of my  Penelope 🙏💕 so grateful to have my baby shark back and feeling better 🐕🐾

friendly professional caring and accommodating.
Staff treats your babies (pets) with love and respect

Although my baby has passed away on 5/24/26, I am deeply grateful to Dr. Holly Thompson for her kind explanations when my pet was first diagnosed, and I also thank the hospital staffs for taking such good care of my Nova. When I was told that my cat's condition was poor and we needed to transfer her to a hospital with 24-hour admission, Dr. Holly Thompson immediately and urgently recommended a hospital with a cardiologist available for morning duty. However, if such an incident happens to other patients in the future, I hope you will not recommend LASSER Animal Hospital. Even though my cat arrived with her temperature already having dropped to 93 degrees, they left her neglected in a cold, refrigerator-like oxygen room with no care. They did not check her vital signs until the bill was settled, and not only was she not even given a blanket, but the doctor could not even determine her gender until the day after she died which was after 16hrs. I hope you will never recommend LASSER Animal Hospital to any other pets owners again. Thank you for taking such good care of my Nova during her hospitalization. And if you guys can send her x-ray would be great since that’s her last photo that I can remember her

I really am truly thankful for the support I was given by Dr. Linney and among the rest of the staff that attended me and my cat. Although my cat was aggressive, I was given medication for my cat for when he visits future vet appointments. I do suggest that if you have a cat that gets anxious like mine, call before or let the staff know that your cat gets anxious. I wasn’t aware my cat would react like this but luckily Dr. Linney was attentive for my cat and his needs. I truly am appreciative for everyone that helped my cat, and even though the pricing was bit out of my budget, they offer payment plans which i am truly thankful for. The services they offer is reasonable and they have a staff member explain to you every treatment or diagnostics they need for your pet. Again, I am very grateful for this place especially being near where I live.

Our usual vets were closed on Sunday and we came across Animal Urgent Care in Koreatown. They immediately gave off a great vibe and took good care of our dog Lucy. Vets aren't always immediately hospitable and this place made us feel at ease quickly. Even better, their staff is extremely knowledgeable. They followed up with helpful info that has only made our dog healthier. Thankful to have found this place.

YES! absolutely consider taking your pet here. I brought my dog in because he was vomiting and not eating. I didn’t know what was wrong with him and thought he had poisoning. Dr Linney is incredibly knowledgeable and said that it was unlikely poisoning. He was straight-forward, caring and understood about the financial weight of having to pay for pet medical care. Instead of charging for an entire comprehensive check on him, we did a step by step check to figure out what was wrong with my dog. (Would have been thousands of dollars anywhere else) Dr Linney suspected it was an obstruction and he was absolutely correct! We did X-rays and found that my dog had something stuck in his small intestine. He gave me all the resources and information to move forward with this incredibly scary situation; which was to monitor him and have a solid plan for surgery set up just in case. Symptoms got worse and my dog ended up needing the emergency surgery. (The little derp somehow swallowed an ENTIRE toy)
Furthermore proving that he genuinely cares about his patients, Dr Linney personally called me the next day to check up on us. My dog is now recovering well from his surgery and getting his groove back.
Everyone in this office is friendly and helpful. I never felt rushed or scammed, like I have at other pet medical centers in the past.

I took my pug to this veterinary hospital on July 20 because he was having a severe allergic reaction. His paws were extremely swollen, and his entire body was bright red. I was very worried about his condition and expected him to receive the proper treatment.

Unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing. The veterinarian only gave him a pain injection and a Benadryl injection. They also recommended additional tests that would have brought the total cost to about $1,300. Because of the high cost, I decided not to proceed with those tests. In the end, I paid around $300 for the visit, and the only medication they recommended was Benadryl, which I could have purchased myself at any pharmacy.

Since my dog was not improving, I took him to another veterinary clinic. There, they immediately prescribed antibiotics and started the treatment he needed. He began improving after receiving the proper care.

I don’t understand why, after seeing my dog in such poor condition, this hospital did not provide a more appropriate treatment from the beginning. Instead, I felt they were more focused on recommending expensive tests before treating him.

This was my personal experience. I would not return to this hospital, and unfortunately, I cannot recommend it.

My mom fed my dog steak that was seasoned with onions, garlic, and other spices, which made him very sick. I couldn't get an appointment with his primary veterinarian, so I brought him here for emergency care.

From the moment I arrived, the front desk staff was kind, compassionate, and explained the entire process clearly. They also provided pricing upfront, which I really appreciated.

Next, one of the veterinary staff members took my dog into the exam area. They were incredibly thorough and asked detailed questions to gather as much information as possible before the veterinarian examined him.

After that, there was a wait. Be prepared for that mentally. In my case, the wait was longer because an emergency patient had arrived, which is completely understandable.

I was seen by Dr. Travis Linney, DVM, MBA, MS, and he was outstanding. He answered every one of my questions in detail and reassured me that my dog wasn't about to die. At the time, I truly believed he might because he wasn't eating or drinking.

I returned the following day because nothing had changed and I still had concerns. Dr. Linney was just as patient during my second visit. He never rushed me, took the time to watch a short video I had recorded of my dog struggling to walk, and advised me to give him a few more days to recover.

It ultimately took eight days before my dog finally started eating and drinking on his own again. Today, his personality is back, he's running around like himself again, and I'm so grateful for the care he received.

As for the cost, here's the breakdown:
$135 (To be seen)
$1099.20(see photo)
Blood Panel, X-Rays, body exam etc…

48 Hours to bring pet back for check up. Free of charge. But don’t quote me.
They were all really great.

I called in asking explaining my situation, they worked so quick in checking if my baby could be seen. Check in was easy, they were fast to see her and take her in for vitals. After a few minutes I was able to get some feedback in what we were looking at, went over options & worked with me and my budgeting. Never did they push me into something I didn’t want. At the end they were able to make her feel more comfortable, and are open to calls and messages any time after the visit. I definitely recommend and will be using them if need. Thank you to the whole team!
I like their service. The vet answer all my questions .

10/10 experience. We took our cat in for an emergency and they took care of us right away. Dr. Breanna Goodman took the time to address all our concerns and questions. She was very thorough with care and transparent about pricing and only recommended what was necessary at the time. The receptionists and vet tech were amazing to work with as well. We felt like the office genuinely cared about or cat and finding a solution, vey grateful for the care and information. Thank you to the staff for making this a stress free experience.

I took a stray cat here because it's close to home. All I needed at the moment was a health and wellness check for it even though it wasn't an urgent situation. They were kind enough to take me in. Understandably they attend to the urgent patients first so it was a wait but I did not mind so long as I knew the stray was on good hands. The pricing was also affordable (for myself). I would def recommend this place to anyone whether it's urgent or not. They take care of your needs

This clinic is amazing they helped my cat Lola so much in an emergency. I was so scared when I brought her in and I had no idea what was wrong.. she was Vomitting, not eating, not playing, had a bad infection, thankfully the Dr. Morgan was able to diagnose her correctly and start on medication that helped her within the couple days!! 3 days ago I was a terrified cat mom and now my baby is back to normal eating drinking and playing with her sister. I highly recommend this place. The staff are all so kind and helpful… I was also on a budget and they completely adjusted the treatment plan to my budget and did everything they could for lola and I. Thank you Dr. Morgan and staff for helping my baby!!! I appreciate you all so much ❤️ (the photo below is her after the treatment, her face is completely lively again) so so happy and grateful.

First time going to Animal Urgent Care and we are so happy we found this place!
Dr. Goodman, the nurses, and the front desk personnel were all super friendly and excellent at each of their roles.
They explained every single detail before we committed to any service. Their attention to our sweet pup was amazing!

I want to truly thank Dr. Travis and the whole team at animal urgent care for helping us with our baby whiskey. Every single  person on the team was super caring, attentive and cordial.  It was such a hard visit and the team walked us through everything we needed to do with such beautiful professionalism and care.  I thank you all from the bottom of my heart!!!

I DID NOT TAKE MY DOG HERE

Called to take my dog that had hurt himself. They staff quoted 130 for regular exam but can't give estimate on how much an xray is? Staff stated they weren't allowed. Very fishy Vet. Read the previous reviews apparently they over charge and are overpriced.

Definitely recommend this vet.
I had to take my cat here on a Sunday because he was apparently incredibly constipated. I ended up spending around 4 hours there and loved everything about it. The place is clean and the staff is friendly and professional. The area is full of pretty affordable restaurants and caffes if you need to kill time while waiting for procedures.
I only waited half an hour for the x-ray and only a few hours for the other procedures and observation period.
The examination fee of 135$ is a bit higher than the affordable vet services out here (some are as low as 35$) but it's worth the price, considering they are open every day from 12:00 to 22:00.
I have pet insurance for my cat and their online portal makes it super easy to retrieve all the documents needed for a claim. They might not become my main vet  for regular checkups due to the high upfront cost but they are great for emergencies and larger procedures.
I am so happy I found this place! Many thanks to everyone at Animal Urgent Care K-Town who helped me and my boy :)

I took my senior dog Woody to get attended to for a nail that got torn from his paw as we were in the area (and his normal vet was closed). Upon following up with his regular vet, he said they “did a shitty job”.

The staff were extremely polite/caring, I just don’t know if I would bring him back (or recommend them to anyone).

My dog ate iron fertilizer and I was freaking out! I called before I went around 4:30 PM and they told me there was no wait so I went! Super professional, warm, and I had a great experience! So thankful my dog is okay :)

Animal Urgent Care K-Town accepted my cat Onyx as a same day walk in, and the staff was sweet, kind, and professional. They took great care of him and referred us to an ophthalmologist for his eye. Although the visit was a bit pricey, my cat's health matters most. I'm grateful for the excellent care they provided.
Excellent service. Very helpful in a time of crisis
Very friendly and they have staff who speak Spanish and a very professional doctor and their staff who greet you, I would give them a 10👍 …

I really enjoyed the excellent service and the doctors were very kind. They treated us very well; my dog ​​was very well received and cared for. My family and I are very grateful. Thank you, and I highly recommend them.
Happy to have found this place where they treated my pet quickly and very professionally, thanks to all the staff who were always aware of the health of my Baby Leo.

My husband and I brought in our dog for care. He was having an allergic reaction but we weren't aware... we just knew something was terribly wrong. They gave the care and attention needed to help our dog feel better and also guided us on what to do if it happens again. We are very grateful for the care we received.

Dr. Linney is the best vet I’ve ever experienced in my 28 years of having dogs! After I brought my dog to a different vet (for what I’m learning was an IVDD episode), and she got worse, I found myself in the Koreatown office with Dr. Linney- who took the time to not only address all my concerns, but thoroughly explain them to me in a way no vet has ever cared enough to take the time to. Not only was my wait time extremely short, but after the previous vet sent me into a state of panic with vague terms and predictions like she might be paralyzed forever… Dr. Linney took the time to literally draw out what was happening with my dog and explain it to me in extreme detail, making me feel more safe and optimistic about my dogs experience. He immediately addressed all potential happenings, and provided me so much clarity when the other vet left me with more confusion, and more debt. You can tell that both him & his office GENUINELY care about your pet, and aren’t just in it to charge you an arm and a leg! Not only that, but he provided me medication my dog was missing from the previous vet that she should’ve been given! I’ve never felt more supported by not only compassion, hospitality, and care- but also with information and logistics! I have never felt more positive about my dogs safety, experience, and recovery!  Thank you so much Dr. Linney and the rest of the staff!! 12/10 experience! So grateful for everything you do and your care for animals! Sending love!

I love this place. It super stressful having your fur baby sick and also super stressful to find a place where they will treat them kindly and this urgent care is the best. I've been there 3 times and I will be forever thankful for the kindness of this team. Best pet urgent care

The staff here is friendly and professional. I had to urgently bring my dog in for diarrhea and was seen right away on a Friday night. Most vets have a hard time handling my dog as she gets very anxious but they were able to pick her up swiftly with no problem. I also appreciated Dr Goodman following up and asking how my dog is doing after being sent home with medication.

(Staff has been harassing me in my review comments on Reddit.)
Refused to emergency test my dogs stool for Parvo.Money wasn’t an issue, yet I kept being offered “more affordable options”. The vet demanded that I physically bring in my dog. Which is unnecessary and would cost me an extra fee. They refused to provide the emergency service I came in for. The vet wouldn’t even come to the front to discuss the issue.
They overcharge but they’re very attentive.

I did not like this place. My cat had gotten sick and I felt like they weren’t much help nor were they compassion.

I wouldn’t come back.

I never leave reviews, but this place SUCKS! The experience was beyond unacceptable. I brought my dog here for urgent care and waited SEVEN hours with little to no communication from staff. When I finally asked for an update, instead of empathy or professionalism, I was met with attitude and yelling from a staff member who tried to justify the wait by saying “all these dogs are dying.” If that’s truly the level of emergency care needed, then perhaps this facility should not market itself as urgent care when it clearly cannot handle the volume appropriately.

The entire experience was chaotic, disorganized, incredibly expensive, and emotionally exhausting. When people bring their pets in, they’re already scared and stressed. The way I was spoken to was completely unacceptable.

I understand veterinary staff are under pressure, but that does not excuse poor communication, dismissive behavior, or treating worried pet owners like an inconvenience. I would not return here and would not recommend this place to anyone expecting compassionate or competent urgent care unless you want to spend over a thousand dollars and get disgusting pushback from a 20 year old with bad eyeliner

This is a smaller but nice facility with a super attentive and friendly staff. We had a slight emergency so we called first to see if they could even take us on a late Saturday afternoon, the answer was more than reassuring. Within a short time we got to seeing the Veterinarian on duty who sat with us privately to discuss the procedure. We then waited a couple of hours, and at least another half for check out, the cost was comparatively reasonable and fair. All patched up, our pup came out of the procedure excited to see us! She had a ripped claw on a paw that was excruciatingly painful for her so to see her come out like her old self was awesome. Definitely would recommend this facility to a friend/family.
Tried pushing a $16k+ surgery on my dog that they knew wouldn't survive. Instead of being honest with me about it and not making my dog suffer they prolong the whole process.

Cannot speak highly enough of this place!! The staff are so caring for you and your pet in every way and give above and beyond! Dr Linney is literally the best vet I’ve ever had! Kevin you can tell really loves animals, he’s so compassionate, warm & kind…. And Jackie & Chantal are awesome to deal with in what’s always not a great situation with a sick pet (mine being my dogs, one that I had to put down here). I never EVER write reviews but these guys deserve the extra credit! Bring your pets here! They listen to you! They don’t try to force you to spend on tests you don’t need! They care!!

this was the most thorough and most communicative urgent care experience ive ever had ( both as a human and for my pet). I work in health care and know that cost is always a factor that typically is misunderstood with insurance. My sister is a vet tech in NYC and was shocked by the cost of my cat's care. It was about half of what we expected. The vet's were very attentive to my cat and then put me in a private room to discuss cost and options. They even coordinated with me a pickup time around my job. Dr Montanoya and her team were very accomodating of me and my emotions about the day.  She explained her surgery very thoroughly and my cat is thankfully feeling himself again. I would def go here if you have an emergency compared to an ER!

Amazing place! Every staff member I interacted with were beyond calm, kind, and helpful. The final bill was inexpensive in my opinion, but my pup only needed some staples and antibiotics for a gash; no X-rays or other procedures needed. Thank you Doctor Lee and staff for helping my baby and I!! ♥️

Unfortunately, I had to visit this hospital because I took my furry princess there after she was attacked by a dog. She arrived with several spinal fractures. They were honest in telling me that nothing could be done for her, and we decided to have her euthanized as it was the best thing for her. Thank you for the excellent care you gave us.

Absolutely wonderful experience here with my anemic cat. When my primary care vet's external blood lab ruined their blood sample, they rescheduled me two days later for an in-house retry. The Urgent Care was able to do same-day labs, analysis, and recommendation for further treatment at an emergency facility.

The staff show sympathy in their communication. Despite being busy, the techs and vet provided frequent updates. I will be returning if any of my cats have an issue beyond primary care in the future.
Fast service, nice staff and doctor, not expensive, clean, the doctor explained easy and slow to understand. I recommend the place.

I took in my sick kitten yesterday and they treated her and made sure all was good and she was stable before we went home. Dr Lee was compassionate and professional and patient while explaining the condition and treatment for my loved companion. 100% recommend this clinic!

I brought my senior pittie-lab mix to Animal Urgent Care during an emergency, and I cannot say enough about how friendly and kind the staff were. From the very first phone call, they were incredibly warm, patient, and reassuring, which made such a stressful situation feel much more manageable.

When we arrived, the wait time was very short, and the entire team continued to be welcoming and attentive. Dr. Ji Lee was extremely thorough and took the time to clearly explain everything she found during the exam, along with her recommendations for testing and next steps.

Overall, I was very happy with the care we received. Their friendliness and professionalism really stood out, and I would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing urgent care for their pet.

My cat Mila was going through a urinary blockage that needed immediate attention so my primary vet recommended Animal Urgent Care of K-town as they had no availability.   I called and was able to have Mila seen within an hour.  I suspected my cat's urinary blockage was due to sturuvite crystals in her bladder but after sending in a urine sample to the lab she ended up having Feline Idiopathic Cystitis (FIC).  The staff I interacted with were very professional and kind.  Dr. Breanna Goodman helped explain the symptoms and treatment needed in order to treat my girl's condition.   The Doctor's follow up was also very extensive which is appreciated.   I'd come back here for sure if any other emergency treatement is needed, hopefully not.

I have gone twice now for emergencies with two different dogs and the care is always top notch. They go above and beyond to make sure your pets are safe and healthy, and quickly referred us to a specialty hospital when one of my dogs needed a quick life saving procedure. I would highly recommend them to anyone.

have tried to go here twice but they’re always packed. it’s not their fault they’re seemingly the only urgent care around here but disappointed that, on our second visit, they told me about the long wait time AFTER i paid them the exam fee. they first told me it was a 30-60 minute wait, which is was fine with me since I had already paid the fee. 10 minutes later they told me that the wait would be hourslong. while there is a drop-off option, my dog gets too anxious at the vet and we’ve never had to wait “hours” to be seen. so i decided to choose what was best for my dog in that moment considering that I couldn’t even be reunited with him until a vet saw him (also, who knows what conditions the dogs are in when they’re placed on hold so i didn’t want to take the risk).

i will not be back here as the both times have left us desiring more. furthermore, it sucks that the customer can’t get a copy of the exam or anything.

beware if you’re looking to come here! i suggest asking for the wait time BEFORE they have you pay the fee & sign documents, which they will verbally summarize in their words and won’t give you the option to read!

I had to bring in my sweet senior rescue greyhound after he lost all neurological functioning in his right side. His quality of life would have continued to deteriorate and compassionate euthanasia was the only kind (yet- most difficult and extremely excruciating) choice. The doctors and staff at Animal Urgent Care were beyond professional, knowledgeable, caring and supportive. I just received a card in the mail signed by all 8 of them each with a hand written and signed - message of condolence and it truly touched my family and I's hearts. I would highly recommend them to all pet owners.

This is what I wrote  to this health provider:

Dear Dr. J.L.,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my concerns regarding our recent visit to your clinic with my dog. While I appreciate the care provided to animals, I was disheartened by the attitude and assumptions exhibited during our appointment.

I want to clarify that I have never used methamphetamine in my life. It was both surprising and upsetting to hear you suggest that my dog's condition could be attributed to my personal choices. This assumption was not only inaccurate but also unprofessional. As a pet owner, I take my responsibilities seriously, and attributing my dog's illness to my character is not only misguided but also damaging.

Giving me an attitude and attempting to shut me up during our conversation last night was unprofessional. If you are unhappy with your job, it is not the client’s responsibility to bear the brunt of that dissatisfaction. Clients are the reason for your practice, and without them , there will be no job.You should be thanking me for seeking care for my dog rather than giving me an attitude.
I also want to emphasize the seriousness of providing incorrect information.

Making baseless assumptions can have significant consequences. And it is very serious matter when it comes to slander. I urge you to be more careful with your words in the future.

Furthermore, your reaction to my husband’s inquiry regarding my health was uncalled for. It is essential for healthcare professionals to maintain a level of professionalism and empathy, especially when dealing with concerned pet
owners. Such judgments can create an uncomfortable and distressing environment for those seeking help for their beloved animals.

I hope that you can understand my perspective on this matter. It is crucial for both pet owners and veterinary professionals to communicate openly and respectfully to ensure the best care for our animals.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I trust that you will reflect on this experience to foster a more compassionate atmosphere for your clients in the future.

Sincerely,

GV

Re: Formal Complaint Against Dr. Arlett Montoya

To Whom It May Concern,

I want to start by saying the front desk staff was kind and  proffesional. On 9/30/25 at 7:58pm I brought my dog, Bijou, a Shar-Pei, to an urgent care facility under the care of Dr. Arlett Montoya. Bijou presented with a dangerously high fever, which I confirmed at home using two separate thermometers, both reading 104.4°F. I communicated this clearly to the staff upon arrival and requested that urgent, immediate care be provided to bring down her fever.
Despite this, Dr. Montoya refused to provide even basic supportive treatment—such as cooling measures or fever-reducing medication—until I authorized an excessive treatment plan totaling approximately $1,860.
The breakdown of costs presented to me was:
•	$135 for the exam fee (already paid upon entry)
•	$289 for bloodwork
•	$369 for urine cytology
•	$189 for IV line administration
•	$289 for IV fluids
•	$589 for x-rays
•	Additional “miscellaneous” fees for interpretation of results

This inflated package was presented as a prerequisite to any treatment, even though my dog was actively in distress. When I requested immediate fever reduction with meloxicam or another safe alternative like alcohol cotton pads on her feet, Dr. Montoya dismissed my request and admonished me to “be more polite.”, in an attempt to humiliate me. My dog was treated because I BEGGED HER TO PLEASE GIVE ME THE SAME GRACE she would give her other patients and treat my dog. She wanted to punish me for being an informed Shar Pei owner.

I want to emphasize that throughout the consultation, I remained calm, respectful, and professional despite my anxiety. I consciously maintained a soft tone and courteous demeanor to ensure my dog received care. Despite this, Dr. Montoya withheld basic, time-sensitive treatment.

At discharge, my dog was returned to me with a gash on her leg, and fluids were given subcutaneously instead of intravenously. This demonstrates either negligence or a lack of proper skill, especially since the staff themselves noted how calm and cooperative Bijou was throughout the visit.
Additionally, Dr. Montoya misrepresented my dog’s medical condition. She told me that Bijou’s temperature had lowered to 102°F. Later, a veterinary technician admitted this was untrue—her temperature remained at 104°F, and they were merely “hoping it would decrease.”

In the end, I was refunded part of the $600 charged upfront because the clinic could not provide the treatment they insisted upon. Instead, Dr. Montoya pushed for 24-hour hospitalization, which I believe was financially motivated rather than medically necessary.

This experience leads me to conclude that this urgent care facility—and specifically Dr. Arlett Montoya—prioritizes profit over animal welfare. My dog’s health and safety were jeopardized due to unnecessary financial barriers, dishonesty, and a refusal to provide basic fever-reducing treatment.

I respectfully request that the Veterinary Medical Board investigate this matter thoroughly, as the conduct of Dr. Montoya falls below the standard of veterinary care and placed my pet’s life in danger.

They do not deserve your trust or your money.

TL;DR: If you want a hospital that pressures you with “Swipe your card NOW or your puppy will die” urgency, then after you pay, dumps your traumatized puppy — mauled in a pitbull attack — in the back for 8 hours, charges outrageous fees for surgery, abandons her the moment she wakes up from anesthesia, refuses to answer questions or even do mandatory suture removal, and then has the head doctors personally call and email you just to insult your family instead of providing care — this is the place.

I brought my puppy at 1 PM. They rushed me to sign anesthesia and surgery papers, saying it was urgent and demanding immediate payment. After I paid, she was thrown in the back and left for 8+ hours with no updates. At around 3 PM, staff told us the surgery would only take a couple of hours and that they’d call us with updates. Those calls never came. Every time we checked in, all we got was “soon, soon.” Surgery wasn’t done until close to midnight, and she was discharged with no aftercare instructions, no paperwork, and no explanation of what even happened.

My father, a 67-year-old POC dad with broken English, got visibly emotional and raised his voice after being denied any access to the vet. Keep in mind this was at around 11pm after we had been waiting since 2PM. For this, the next morning I was told in the most condescending tone that my dog was “no longer welcome" due to my father's conduct and to seek care elsewhere and that no questions would be answered and no further care would be possible. Even when I offered to handle everything myself or send a third party, they refused.

The next morning she wasn’t in good condition, and I simply wanted to know if what I was seeing was normal. They refused to answer. By 48 hours post-surgery, her stitches looked to be splitting open — I could see how deep the wound was — and she was clearly not doing well. When I begged for help, head doctor and the founder of this urgent care center, Ryan called me — not to give medical guidance, but to say “your father was a huge jerk.” Another doctor, Travis, emailed me in the same tone, exaggerating my father’s behavior and, in my view, insulting me instead of taking responsibility. He even tried to defend themselves by hiding behind a veterinarian mental health nonprofit (NOMV), which I believe was manipulative given the situation.Even after I apologized on my father’s behalf, they still refused to see her, refused to reassess her wound, and basically just said “oh well, we did everything on our part, so anything afterwards isn’t our responsibility.”

On top of all this, they charged what I experienced as outrageously high fees for the surgery, testing, and medication. In my opinion, the pricing felt like they were taking advantage of pet owners in a desperate situation, while taking no accountability afterward.

Yes, dog parents can get emotional — but abandoning a recovering puppy is indefensible. From the front desk to the head doctors, this was the lowest of the low in my experience. There are far better emergency hospitals in Los Angeles like MASH and VCA — save yourself the trauma and go there instead.

And if you’re reading this, Animal Urgent Care — please don’t bother calling me again just to tell me what a terrible person I am, or how I’m somehow responsible for destroying the mental health of veterinarians everywhere. My focus is my puppy, not your excuses.

I once went to LAASER Los Angeles Animal Specialty, Emergency & Rehabilitation on N. San Fernando Rd., and they wouldn't even start until I had signed multiple papges and put down a $1,000 deposit even though the kitten was crying in pain. I understand sometimes people can't/don't pay, but I think the priority is always saving an animal's life first... especially a stray. I believe that we all need to contribute what we can. It was still quite a lot of money but considering it was manageable and I was speedily able to get the help I needed, it was worth it. The best pet Urgent Care experience we’ve had in LA. The intake team was fast, kind, and professional and Dr. Linney was truly amazing. He sat with us and worked to figure out what was going on with our pup and got to the root problem (something we’ve been trying to do with other vets for 2+ years). He figured out what was going on and told us our options for diagnostics. He didn’t pressure us to do every test he thought of and he let us choose the most important tests that were in our budget. I’ve also never seen such efficient use of time at a veterinary office - other patients were moving through in a reasonable amount of time, too.
